      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "darosior replied explaining that half-close sends FIN giving POLLIN, so behaviour does not change, though RSTs would disconnect early; darosior later converted PR to draft to pursue an alternative instead of litigating this",

        "rc:4668884538",
        "rc:4669700945",

      ],

      "status_by_id": "rc:4668884538",
      "status_by_quote": "I think this is incorrect. A half close sends a FIN, and poll() returns POLLIN for this. So this commit does not change behaviour in this case."
